ceiling.determinacy_ceiling_source: Meng et al., SyDIT, PLDI 2011: 39 of 56 (70%) of real systematic edits mimicked by a full inducer
ceiling.note: even with every consequence observable, one demonstration caps correctness at its determinacy; observability is the multiplier, not the base

computer_use.external_context: OSWorld 2.0 (arXiv 2606.29537): best agent 20.6% of 108 workflows, failing by skipping verification and spending under 7% of budget detecting its own errors

horizon.why: a per-action check only ever asks about the action in front of it, so a legal step that falsifies an earlier verified fact is invisible to it. Re-validating exactly the facts the current step frame can touch costs one hash per fact and localises the cause two steps before the symptom

novel.why: with nothing recorded, only a crash and a no-op are visible; a wrong result that looks like a result is invisible without a specification

oracle_synthesis.why: the oracle is not a predicate to be written but an observation to be chosen, under two tests at once: it must separate the action from the ways it can be wrong, and it must reproduce itself on replay. Separation alone admits a timestamp; stability alone admits a name listing

prospective.evaluated_on: a binding never executed during acquisition
prospective.why: a consequence differential only exists after acting and only on a seen binding. A contract acquired from one execution is the prospective form of the same check: the frame -- which paths the action may touch -- carries most of it, a declared or derived relation carries the bytes, and what remains is a located hole in the vocabulary

replay.why: the intent is the recorded consequence, so any difference is an error: with a full state observation every wrong action is caught, and a wrong action that leaves the state identical did not miss the goal

computer_use.what_remains_unmeasured: a GUI whose only observable is pixels or DOM -- a projection, not the state -- and what to do after an invalidation: the ledger proves a fact false and does not repair it, and a fact carried by remote state rather than by a path is outside it
computer_use.what_was_run: 34 mechanically derived wrong actions over 9 real shell transformations, real programs on a real disk, real reset

law: P(correct behaviour | one action) = P(determined) x P(seen); P(seen) = density x strength

check_density.reason: a property of the environment: manufactured checks (recorded-outcome differential, idempotence/reversibility invariants, state-projection diffs) can raise it from 0.6788 toward 1.0, and each manufactured check is falsifiable by mutation before use

check_strength.reason: assertion quality: strong-oracle patches merge 28% more often (arXiv 2606.18168), and a check that a mutation does not kill is not a check

determined.reason: a property of the trace, not of the learner: one demonstration is one point, and the published ceiling for a full inducer is 0.70 on real systematic edits

check_density.meaning: real python edits any existing test even names

check_strength.meaning: a behavioural mutant is rejected where the check can see it

determined.meaning: a demonstration determines the sibling edit

determined_value.meaning: an inferred literal is the literal that was needed

memory_exact.meaning: of all real sites, the share a permanent memory serves exactly

seen.meaning: density x strength: a wrong edit is visible

silent_corruption.meaning: a replay that holds the parse and changes the behaviour

what_this_shows: P(correct) = determined x seen = 0.5469 x 0.5445 = 0.2978 on real python work, and 0.1167 when the action turns on a value. Leverage is not slope: the two slopes are 0.5445 and 0.5469, but only the observation is engineerable (leverage 0.5469 against 0.0), because determinacy is a property of the trace with a published ceiling of 0.7. At full observability the same determinacy still caps correctness at 0.5469. Memory serves 0.1584 of work at all and replays 0.0481 exactly, with 0.3114 silent corruption.
